_about: The device-only storage keys (localStorage unless `store` says otherwise), each with why it never leaves this device in a backup or the cloud copy. Every key that does is a DESK_DATASETS row in app.js instead (backup and cloud field names, sign-in safety copy, change check), so each key is listed in exactly one place. Checked by tests/verify_storage_keys.mjs: a key the app uses that is in neither fails.

cos_attendance_v2.why: reserved: attendance v2 store, nothing reads or writes it yet; add to backups before it goes live

cos_att_v2_state.why: device setting: which attendance math this device shows

cos_cloud_signed_in.why: per-device; index.html reads it at startup

cos_firebase_config.why: developer override of the Firebase config

cos_notified_history.why: which reminders and onboarding cards this device showed

cos_vault.why: file bytes; backups embed them through customLinks

cos_corrupt_.why: a damaged saved value kept once by safeGetStorage, for repair

cos_weekly_review_dismissed_.why: one key per dismissed week (this device only); dismissing removes the older weeks' keys
